name: com.rubickanov.app
description: No-DI glue for a game: services made by hand in an app scope and a scene scope, a Lifecycle that says what of theirs runs where in Unity's frame (time tick, early tick, start, tick, fixed and physics ticks, pre-late and late ticks) and disposes them last made first, a FrameLoop that puts those places into the player loop. A step that throws is logged once per kind and the others go on.
